newsitem.title: USA: Iteq names John Camardella president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Iteq names John Camardella president, COO.

text.p: ITEQ Inc said Friday that it has named John Camardella president and chief operating officer, a newly created position.

The company said his proven track record in assimilating acquisitions will allow ITEQ to continue its strategy of acquiring niche leaders in the highly fragmented process equipment supplier base to multinational customers.
Camardella, said the company, was previously president and CEO of ABB Global Paint Finishing, a unit of Asea Brown Boveri Ltd.

In other news, the company said that it has signed a definitive purchase agreement with respect to its previously announced $10 million acquisition of privately-held Exell Inc, which makes shell-and-tube heat exchangers. The purchase is expected to close in June.
ITEQ is a provider of manufactured equipment, engineered systems and services used in the processing, treatment and movement of gases and liquids.
